response.overview: FOREVER AND EVER – THOSE YEARS ARE OVER is a short slasher film about three friends: Paul, Jonas and Alex. When Paul and Jonas are waiting for Alex to return with food, a mysterious caller begins contacting them, and a masked Ghostface suddenly appears in the apartment. The two friends are captured and tied to chairs while the killer plays a disturbing game with them. However, the biggest twist comes when Ghostface removes his mask
response.title: Those years are over
